comparison.objective: Turn over a taped carton, cut its bottom seal, open all bottom flaps and flatten the carton; candidate screens ceramic media from retained metal washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-carton turnover, guarded blade cutting, flap articulation and flattening versus load-shared screen grasping, granular pouring, aperture flow control and agitation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires measured upright-to-inverted turnover, complete tape cut, opened bottom, all flaps coplanar, flat released carton and 1 s dwell; candidate requires mass-based media recovery with washer retention and a released screen dwell.
comparison.reason: Carton disassembly does not test size/orientation-dependent granular separation. The draft lacks task.json and native feasibility evidence, but all supplied source versions include explicit scoring thresholds sufficient for comparison.
